full_page.content:
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 11
Inside front cover.
Quote from Moore on God, Life, and Light of the world
Newspaper copy of poem, "The Ancient Church of Rome". by Rev. Charles Edward Stowe.
Newspaper copy of poem, "Wishing".
Pg. 1. Typed copy of poem by his sister Margaret for their Parents Golden Jubilee in Seattle October 6, 1913.
Pg. 2. Names and addresses of parishioners at Sacred Heart Church, Yonkers, New York.
Pg. 3. Newspaper copy of poem, "The Trailing Arbutus", by Rev. E.C. Casey (brother of Fr. Solanus).
Pg. 4. Names and addresses of parishioners - Yonkers, N.Y.
Pg. 5. Donations beside the names on pg. 4.
Pg. 6. Newspaper copy of Easter Week by Joyce Kilmer in Extension Magazine - "Romantic Ireland" by William Butler Yeats, poem.
Newspaper copy of Pearse's Last Letter.
Pg. 7. Newspaper copy of the continuation of "Romantic Ireland".
Newspaper copy of poem written by Thomas Ashe in Prison, "Let Me Carry Your Cross F Ireland, Lord."
Under the Title Fr. Solanus wrote by hand: "before his cruel murder by British trying to break his hunger - strike".
Pg. 8. Newspaper copy of the continuation of poem by Thomas Ashe.
1917, November
Pg. 9. Newspaper copy of poem "Hustle and Grin".
